title: ieee1905: Sync Message and TLV with EasyMesh SPEC v5.0
description:
EasyMesh dissector update:
1. Remove deprecated definition of Message and TLV
2. Add new messages and TLVs based on v5.0

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 6c0f1927 - ieee1905: Fix typo
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12314/diffs?diff_id=801423264&start_sha=97b84ea000bfa0d78b3651e7f90b31e8b3acd214)
Why remove ? it will broke dissection of old pcap ?

There is conflict between new definition and old definition.

#define LOOP_PREVENTION_MECHANISM_SETTING_TLV   0xD6
#define LOOP_DETECTION_SEQUENCE_NUMBER_TLV      0xD7
#define GROUP_INTEGRITY_KEY_TLV                 0xD8
#define CAC_STATUS_REQUEST_TLV                  0xD9
#define PACKET_FILTERING_POLICY_TLV             0xDA

#define ANTICIPATED_CHANNEL_PREFERENCE_TLV      0xD6
#define ANTICIPATED_CHANNEL_USAGE_TLV           0xD7
#define SPATIAL_REUSE_REQUEST_TLV               0xD8
#define SPATIAL_REUSE_REPORT_TLV                0xD9
#define SPATIAL_REUSE_CONFIG_RESPONSE_TLV       0xDA
#define QOS_MANAGEMENT_POLICY_TLV               0xDB
#define QOS_MANAGEMENT_DESCRIPTOR_TLV           0xDC
#define CONTROLLER_CAPABILITY_TLV               0xDD

I checked SPEC 3.0, 4.0 and 5.0. Also look into history about theses changes.
The old version is committed by Richard before SEPC 3.0 release.
These changes should be based on Draft 3.0 from WFA.
In WFA local branch, these TLVs are removed when adding new TLVs for 4.0
So these old definition should not be used and we can remove these TLVs.
From Upstream historical changes, I only saw Richard(WFA) updating Message and TLV.
Also based on SPEC 3.0, 4.0 and 5.0. These TLVs are replaced.

This commit is on Jun 28 2020.
If there is any concern I am not sure I can get more information about these changes from Richard.
can you squash the change ? it will be more easy for us to backport to 4.2
